notes: Hollow's tombstones stand up front in the near left corner, in the grass (CEO 2026-10-01: "put them up front on the left in the grass"). Their feet sink below the frame and a slice of the painting's own foreground grass is laid back over…
The stones' purple and orange lights dance: quick, uneven wavers, the light pools swaying, and the light spilling over the grass.

Dust drifts through the whole of Hollow and Vigil, each mote lit by whatever light is near it: moonlight high on the left, candle-orange by the lanterns, purple and orange by the stones, green by the ghost. Elsewhere it is nearly dark.
